name: Zazuar (Spain)
description: Square flag of three vertical stripes, red of 0.3, a blue wavy stripe of 0.1 and white of 0.6, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Zazuar (a castle on red and a tree on white).
history: The arms and the flag were defined in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 233 of 30 November 2001; the flag is square, 1:1, tricolour in vertical stripes of 0.3 red, 0.1 blue wave and 0.6 white, with the municipal arms at its heart.
